limitations.text: No imagery usable: imagery_window for GSI aerial and Sentinel-2 returned not_allowed (no imagery source on task), and vision_subagent is not configured. Therefore no candidate was visually verified. Embeddings are synthetic 16-d, 160 m cells (not true 10 m). Few-shot examples were PLATEAU building points on a regular lattice, not necessarily warehouses (could not map to warehouse type), so the similarity is of unknown meaning. 23 candidate sites (score>=0.8), of which 6 are in the stricter upper quartile; ~87 km2 of grid cells scored below threshold and unreviewed. Count range 6-23 is an unverified embedding-only estimate; real warehouse count may differ markedly.

understanding.goal_restated: Find all warehouses/large logistics buildings (>=~1600 m2) in AOI, return points with evidence, count range.
known_limits: 10 m embeddings limit small building discrimination; warehouses vs factories hard to separate; window max 5 km and 512 px.
understanding.scope: AOI ~9x8 km; year 2024; embeddings retrieval then visual verification.
